source.heading: ## TASK-032 / GEN-02a — Candidate resolution + retrieval (issue #33)
source.quote: The seed tags no exercise for `skill_power`, `carries` or `stability_balance`. A profile that enables one of those would fail with `GENERATION_NO_CANDIDATES` for it. That is out of scope here and is not worked around; the default six sections are all populated.

finding.summary: Three optional sections have no catalog rows, so a profile that enables one of them cannot be generated for.
finding.affectedBehavior: a profile that enables skill_power, carries or stability_balance
